name: Glorious Wolf
source: Star Trek / Aliens fanfiction. Rudy, a high school girl and karate champion, attracts the attention of Q, who takes her on an unexpected journey into the future of a humanity she thought doomed.
translation: 星际迷航/外星人同人小说。女高中生、空手道冠军鲁迪吸引了Q的注意，Q带领她踏上了一段意想不到的旅程，进入了她认为注定要失败的人类的未来。
